title: radio.py: parked polling RX blinds later frames in the same wait
description:
## Problem

9098.40 parked a polling RX result so a same-tick RxTimeout cannot drop the only eligible delayed microsecond. The park is broader than that, and it is never consumed.

RadioMixin._handle_event(DelayedRxReadyEvent) always calls _capture_polling_rx. That parks the first success in _pending_poll_rx and then:

1. get_rx_result returns the parked 3-tuple without popping and without calling _get_rx_result_internal.
2. _capture_polling_rx returns immediately if node_id is already in the map.

So the first DelayedRxReady in an RX_WAIT window freezes the polling API on that frame until start_receive / enter_rx_mode / exit_rx_mode / TX start pops the map.

Live (no-latency) polling in one start_receive window can see sequential TXs: after TX1 leaves the medium, the next get_rx_result resolves TX2. With LatencyRule (or any DelayedRxReady), TX1 is parked at expire_us; TX2's later DelayedRxReady is skipped; TX2's stash is pruned when now_us > expire_us. metrics.receptions stays 1.

The 1 ms poll loop described in metrics.py (poll while the node waits; do not re-arm until timeout) hits this for any listen longer than one delayed airtime. test_same_tick_timeout_delivers_polling_rx polls once and never starts a second delayed TX. Park is not limited to "timeout is also at this tick."

## Files

- python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py (_handle_event DelayedRxReadyEvent, _capture_polling_rx, get_rx_result)
- python/src/lichen/sim/events.py (DelayedRxReadyEvent)
- python/tests/sim/test_radio.py (test_same_tick_timeout_delivers_polling_rx)
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-9098.43 (parked polling RX latch; parallel review).
